evidence.observation: Growth-stage entry shows a transient 760.0 °C reading against a 750.0 °C setpoint, with heater power reduced to 37.7%.
Temperature has settled to 750.1 °C against 750.0 °C setpoint with 43.5% heater power; no sustained temperature deviation is evident.
Argon flow is 99.6 sccm against 100.0 sccm setpoint, pressure is 760.8 Torr and stable relative to preceding observations, and controller reports running.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; null O2 values are not a sensor fault.
